chunks.title: TSKB (Industrial Development Bank of Türkiye) (TSKB) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: TSKB (Industrial Development Bank of Türkiye) is a National Development Bank headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Official COP31 Climate Supporter (Green Zone Block C Climate Finance Hub); Türkiye's sole IDFC member. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: €200M Treasury-guaranteed wind, solar & battery storage (BESS) facility + IDFC Climate Implementation Bridge & green corporate investment loans. Source verification: https://www.linkedin.com/in/meralmurathan/.

chunks.title: TSKB Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: TSKB (Industrial Development Bank of Türkiye) provides the following climate financing instruments: Long-Term Investment Loan, MDB On-Lending Credit Line, Green/Sustainability Bond, Apex SME Facility, Advisory. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 2,000,000 to USD 100,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, SME, Mid-Cap Enterprise, Financial Intermediary.

chunks.title: TSKB Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by TSKB (Industrial Development Bank of Türkiye): Renewable Energy, Energy Storage, Industrial Decarbonization, Energy Efficiency, Circular Economy, Women Empowerment & Inclusive Green. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye, EMEA. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: TSKB Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete TSKB's application form: TSKB ERET Environmental & Social Risk Evaluation rating; Turkish EIA (ÇED) permit & renewable license (EPDK) where applicable; Measurable energy efficiency / tCO2e abatement baseline; Audited corporate financials & debt service coverage (DSCR). Explicit exclusion rules: New coal-fired power plants; Environmental non-compliance. Official application portal: https://www.tskb.com.tr/en/corporate-banking/corporate-loans.

chunks.title: TSKB Form Template: Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form
chunks.text: TSKB (Industrial Development Bank of Türkiye) uses the 'Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form' workflow governed by IFC Performance Standards / Harmonized DFI Climate Reporting (10by30 / IDFC). Typical review timeline is 4–12 weeks (Screening -> Due Diligence -> Credit Committee). Form sections required: 1. Sponsor Profile, 2. Transaction Structure, 3. Climate & Impact, 4. Financial Due Diligence, 5. Risk Assessment, 6. Executive Summary.
